Simply put, the most important thing here won't be speed or reflexes, but rather cold calculation and the ability to anticipate what the enemy will do next. One wrong move, and the mission will fail. Will you be able to plot the most efficient route?

The gameplay is based on a unique two-phase approach that demands not just quick reactions, but strategic and deliberate actions. That's why, from the very beginning, you'll carefully study the map, all routes and traps, to choose the best path. And your Reaper will only move once the plan is complete.

Features of the game

Once a route is built, it cannot be corrected. All levels are like a non-standard puzzle The difficulty will gradually increase.

3. Play!

The Bridge is an unusual logic game in which the boundaries of possibility disappear and reality becomes flexible. Gravity obeys your decisions, and perspective changes the meaning of every step.

Journey into the world of the impossible

Welcome to a world inspired by the works of M.C. Escher! Here, conventional logic defies all logic: walls turn into floors, stairs lead to nowhere, and gravity bends at your whim.

Explore unique levels, solving puzzles where every move requires deep thought. Utilize gravity mechanics, unlock alternate versions of levels, and immerse yourself in the game's philosophical atmosphere.

Game features

Hand-drawn graphics that convey the style of Escher's lithographs and illusions. Gravitational anomalies, alternative dimensions and non-standard mechanics. An additional mode with modified levels and a new ending. Time rewind function for freedom of experimentation.
